interpretation_boundaries: This packet freezes a public field, QC, connectome, split, and nuisance-denominator contract only.
The 1,071 processed-subject count is a release ceiling, not an eligible four-run family-separated cohort size.
The public 2017 list of 46 retest subjects must not be substituted for the 45 processed retest subjects in the 2025 release.
Family_ID represents biological sibling grouping and does not prove a shared rearing environment.
A positive delta_mae would be incremental prediction, not neural causation, diagnosis, identity inference, or clinical utility.
No participant row, image, connectome, cognition outcome, model, diagnosis, identity inference, intervention, or solved-frontier claim is produced.

dictionary.endpoint_description: The Fluid Cognition Composite score is derived by averaging the normalized scores of each of the Toolbox tests that are fluid ability measures (Flanker, Dimensional Change Card Sort, Picture Sequence Memory, List Sorting and Pattern Comparison), then deriving scale scores based on this new distribution. One can interpret the Fluid Cognition Composite as a more global assessment of individual and group fluid cognition functioning. Higher scores indicate higher levels of functioning. Unadjusted Scale Score: Participant score is normed to those in the entire NIH Toolbox Normative Sample (18 and older), regardless of age or any other variable, where a score of 100 indicates performance that was at the national average and a score of 115 or 85, indicates performance 1 SD above or below the national average.
dictionary.family_id_description: Lists all Mother_IDs and Father_IDs associated with subjects who share at least one parent. Family_ID does not indicate that siblings grew up in the same household/rearing environment.

question: Can a resting-state connectome predict fluid cognition after family structure, head motion, acquisition signatures, and regional anatomy are denied an escape route?

additional_falsifiers: The incremental value disappears after family separation.
The incremental value disappears or degrades by more than 20% under motion-matched replay.
Median edgewise retest ICC is below 0.40.
Within-subject connectome similarity does not exceed between-subject similarity.
Any S1200 2017 processed image is mixed with a 2025 processed image.
Any family, participant, preprocessing statistic, or outcome crosses the frozen split.

motion_matched_replay.acceptance: delta_mae lower interval bound remains above zero and point estimate remains at least 80% of the primary delta_mae
motion_matched_replay.matching_inputs: motion, run availability, reconstruction version, and QC fields only; no cognition or connectivity

primary_metric.acceptance: lower interval bound is greater than zero
primary_metric.definition: MAE(nuisance-only) minus MAE(nuisance-plus-connectome) on untouched test families
primary_metric.name: delta_mae

primary_partition.algorithm: u = int(first 16 hex digits of SHA256('P059-v1|' + Family_ID), 16) / 2^64; u < 0.70 train, 0.70 <= u < 0.85 validation, otherwise test

reliability_floor.edge_acceptance: median edgewise ICC(2,1) is at least 0.40
reliability_floor.edge_metric: ICC(2,1) over test and retest edge values
reliability_floor.identity_free_acceptance: family-clustered bootstrap lower bound is greater than zero
reliability_floor.identity_free_metric: within-subject connectome-vector correlation minus the between-subject correlation distribution
reliability_floor.threshold_boundary: 0.40 is a preregistered engineering floor, not a clinical reliability standard
